title: Cascade Protocol Conformance Fixture
description: Schema for conformance test fixtures that validate SDK serialization of Cascade Protocol health data types to RDF/Turtle.

id.description: Unique fixture identifier in the format {type-prefix}-{number}, e.g., med-001, cond-002

description.description: Human-readable description of what this fixture tests

dataType.description: The Cascade Protocol data type under test

vocabulary.description: The primary Cascade Protocol vocabulary namespace used

input.description: The data model as a plain JSON object that an SDK would receive as input before serialization. Field names use camelCase mappings of the Turtle predicates.

turtle.description: The expected RDF/Turtle serialization output, including namespace prefix declarations

validationMode.description: How to validate: 'shacl-valid' checks SHACL constraints pass, 'exact-match' requires normalized triple-by-triple equivalence

shouldAccept.description: If true, the input is valid and serialization should succeed. If false, the input violates a constraint and should be rejected.

tags.description: Tags classifying the fixture for filtering and coverage reporting

shaclConstraintViolated.description: For negative fixtures (shouldAccept=false): describes which SHACL constraint is violated, e.g., 'MedicationShape requires clinical:drugName (sh:minCount 1)'

notes.description: Optional explanatory notes about the test case, edge cases, or implementation considerations
